title: Logo color
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a version of the mark against a specific ground. Its shape must remain easy to pick out over both a flat field and a photograph.
strategic_value: Bolt can vary the mark among a small set of colors while retaining its contour and contrast across materials.
demonstration: Four panels show a white mark on blue, a dark mark on gray, a blue mark on a light field and a white mark over photography. The legend calls the gray-panel mark white, although the specimen shows it dark.
practical_value: Compare the actual foreground and background in each panel when choosing a mark color. Use the visible contrast of the gray example to interpret its inconsistent caption.
